summary: More than most people, you swing between a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you build things that last and carry real weight; other days you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: More than most people, you swing between a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you build things that last and carry real weight; other days you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you. The work is holding both without picking a side. Able to carry punishing, transformative work; the risk is harshness.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let discipline and limits and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Able to carry punishing, transformative work; the risk is harshness.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
